cardObtain: [Unidentified] Defeat this monster in Hollow Zero 1 time to obtain its data
cardSkillDesc: In combat, the Abyssal Enforcer will actively evade enemies and activate Vital View, followed by a powerful rush attack. This skill can be countered with Perfect Dodge or Perfect Assist.
desc: The leader of the phantom thieves syndicate "Mockingbird" is not only a master of disguise and deception, but also wields an unpredictable combat style that keeps foes on edge. His colossal scythe appears to exist solely for the purpose of harvesting the "injustices" of the world. The suitcase he carried with him was even more mysterious, concealing the clever tools and deadly weapons needed for his crimes, making every one of his actions filled with uncertainty and danger.
name: Abyssal Enforcer
